title: Test: what a post looks like
lead: This is a test post. It exists so we can see, live, what a piece of writing looks like on the blog: the text, the lists, the code, the table and the images.
s1.title: Text and emphasis
s1.e: . A longer text shows how lines wrap and how comfortable it is to read.
s1.p2: A good reading experience depends on line length, line height and contrast. In a longer paragraph they show up together: the text can't be too narrow or too wide, and it shouldn't tire the eyes in either the light or the dark theme.
s2.title: Lists and a quote
s2.u2: Second point: a little longer, to see how a list item wraps over several lines.
s2.quote: Make it work, make it right, make it fast.
s3.title: Code and a table
s3.p: A short code snippet and a comparison:
s3.r1c3: A new query for every item
s3.note: This is a highlighted note. Warnings and tips appear in a separate box.
s4.title: An image
s4.caption: The image loads from the post’s own folder, like the rest of its files.
own.title: Its own CSS and JS
own.text: A post can have its own stylesheet and script. The grid below comes from this post’s own files. Try it: click the squares.
